# Stephen Irving

## Overview

- **Age:** middle age  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Stephen Irving is a tall, handsome man of middle age with deep-set, dark blue eyes and iron-gray hair. He has a strong, sad face that is splendidly modeled about the chin and brow.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)_

## Personality

Stephen Irving is a high-strung and sensitive individual who possesses a proud demeanor. Behind his reserved exterior lies a deep and tender nature that he scrupulously keeps hidden from the world.

_Sources: [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P8](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0008), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P19](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0019)_

## History

Stephen Irving originally went into business with his uncle in the United [States](../codex/places.md#states), where he married a [Yankee](../codex/factions.md#yankee), and he had a broken engagement in his past with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Years after their past romance ended, his son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) formed a warm connection with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduced them. Stephen eventually returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) wanting to reconnect with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and [Anne](../character/anne.md) helped arrange their reunion at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). After reconciling, Stephen and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) were married in a garden ceremony surrounded by guests before being seen off at the station.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P47](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0047), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P2](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0002), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P3](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0003), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P6](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0006), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P9](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0009), [v2 XV The Beginning of Vacation P11](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0011), +146 more_

## Quotes

> "In Paul’s last letter he spoke of going with you to visit an old . . . friend of mine . . . Miss Lewis at the stone house in Grafton. Do you know her well?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P30](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0030)

> "Yes, I believe you are. Well, I am going to ask a favor of you. I would like to go and see Miss Lavendar if she will let me. Will you ask her if I may come?"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035)

> "There is nothing changed about this house or garden since I was here twenty-five years ago. It makes me feel young again."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P60](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0060)

> "I hardly knew my boy, he had grown so big and brown and sturdy."
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P27](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0027)

> "So this is my little son’s ‘beautiful teacher,’ of whom I have heard so much"
>
> — Stephen Irving — [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P23](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0023)

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lavendar-lewis--stephen-irving.md)

Stephen and [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) were romantically involved and engaged twenty-five years ago, but their engagement was broken off. After learning of her from [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), Stephen sought to reconnect with [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and visited her at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). The two reconciled their past and ultimately married in a garden ceremony surrounded by their friends.

- Romantically involved with — formerly engaged twenty-five years ago  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P36](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0036), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P22](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0022)</sub>
- Spouse of — married in a ceremony  <sub>[v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0030)</sub>
